title: Steamed jasmine rice
steps: Rinse the rice in a sieve under cold water until it runs clear.
Put the rice and water in a pan with a tight-fitting lid. Bring to the boil, cover, then turn the heat to its lowest setting and cook for 12 minutes.
Take off the heat and leave to steam, still covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff up with a fork.
